description: A GUEST ASKS THE HOSTS FOR SOMETHING. Call it when somebody wants to tell the hosts of a wedding or other personal event this connector serves about a need or a question: "I need a vegetarian meal", "I use a wheelchair, is the garden reachable", "can I bring my partner", "when should I arrive from the airport". IT CHANGES NOTHING ON THE EVENT and the reply says so: it files the request for the hosts to read, and you must not tell the person their meal is arranged, their plus one is approved or anything else has been decided. Pass `category` as one of the named values and `note` as what they actually said, in their own words, at most 280 characters. No links and no markup: both are refused. Anybody signed in may send one. Reasons to read out as given: "RATE_LIMITED" means they have sent the hosts several requests already, so say the hosts have them and they can add more later; "BAD_NOTE" means it was empty or too long. It requires a personal connector token, because a request has to come from somebody.

category.description: REQUIRED. What the request is about, one of the named values: dietary, accessibility, plus_one, travel, other. Pick the one that fits what they said and use other rather than forcing one of the first four.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or the event NAME as the hosts spell it.

note.description: REQUIRED. What they are asking for, in their own words, at most 280 characters. Do not add anything they did not say and do not include a phone number, an email address or a link: a link is refused.

name: event_send_request
title: Send the hosts a request about a personal event
